meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 装上后，你抛出任何技术性内容，Claude 会把它拆成 who（谁）、what（是什么）、where（在哪）、why（为什么）、when（何时）五问，用大白话逐条讲一遍。
howto.when: 当你想让某段技术内容被拆成 who、what、where、why、when 的通俗解释时，它会接管。

say.text: 这段太技术了，用大白话讲讲它的 who、what、where、why、when
say.note: Claude 按这五问逐条说明

say.text: 帮我用大白话拆解一下这个技术概念
这个报错太技术了，讲清楚是谁、是什么、为什么

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude takes technical material you bring up and breaks it into a plain-English who, what, where, why, and when.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you want a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

say_en.text: That's mad technical. Give me the who, what, where, why, and when.
say_en.note: Claude answers each of the five in plain English

say_en.text: Break this technical concept down in plain English for me.
Explain this error in plain terms: who, what, and why.
